openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead found. Every lead places the university in Kyiv: Wikipedia/IAU give 'Nemyrovycha-Danchenka St, 2, Kyiv, 01011'; the KNUTD preparatory-department page gives '2 Mala Shyianovska Str.' (possibly the same street under a new name — unverified). Activity leads for 2024-2025: 2024 vstup.osvita.ua admission card; '2025 edition' admission rules on en.knutd.edu.ua; a 2025 welcome notice for postgraduate students naming rector Oleksandra Olshanska. No suspension, merger or licence-revocation lead surfaced in six searches (absence of a search hit is not evidence of status).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Group H profile: no medicine (222), dentistry (221) or nursing (223) programme lead in any search; the only health-related programmes are specialty 226 under the educational programme 'Промислова фармація' (Industrial Pharmacy), run from a Faculty of Chemical and Biopharmaceutical Technologies at a light-industry/design university. Whether this track leads to a pharmacist (провізор) qualification acceptable for professional registration abroad, rather than an industrial-technologist profile, is unverified and must not be implied.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No English-medium teaching lead for any programme; WHED lists 'Ukrainian;Russian;English' only at institution level. The 2024 vstup.osvita.ua 'Відкрита (в т.ч. для іноземців)' marker is a Ukrainian-track admission flag, not evidence of English-medium teaching.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Preparatory-department page snippet ('tuition fee is 1000 USD', enrolment 1 Oct-1 Dec, study@knutd.edu.ua) is undated; do not publish as a current fee.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name-confusion risk: several Kyiv institutions share the 'Kyiv National University of ...' pattern (e.g. Construction and Architecture; Culture and Arts; Taras Shevchenko), and a Study in Ukraine portal hit returned for a KNUTD query was actually NUPH (/university/41). Portal URLs must be matched by title, not by query.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Minor inconsistencies across leads: two addresses (Nemyrovycha-Danchenka 2 vs Mala Shyianovska 2); Wikipedia's rector entry reportedly differs from a 2025 university notice naming Oleksandra Olshanska; enrolment figures differ between directories.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Industrial Pharmacy department page claims to be 'the only higher education institution in Kyiv' training at all levels under 'Industrial Pharmacy' — a self-description, not verified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The FIP 'World List of Pharmacy Schools' and 'most popular with foreign students' claims come from KNUTD's own news items (self-reported; exact news URLs not matched).
